title: Keep it safe
headline: Keep it *safe*
sub: Approvals for money going out, and the app lock.

recap.en: Phones are valuable, and so is the money. How does Ikenna keep it safe?
recap.pcm: Phones get value, money too. How Ikenna go keep am safe?

closing.en: That is Techline Gadgets. Start your free trial.
closing.pcm: Na so Techline Gadgets be. Start your free trial.

flow.purpose: she asks to pay the supplier
flow.action: Looks at her phone, taps Send, then glances across the shop at Ikenna, who is at the counter
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

flow.action: Reads his phone, checks the amount, nods and taps once with a firm smile
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

flow.action: Stands in the shop doorway at dusk, looks back at the tidy glass counter and smiles with quiet pride
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter, evening lamp light

en: He sees who asks, and how much.
First payment to this account: check the details.
He adds a comment. It is recorded.
pcm: He see who ask, and how much.
Na first payment to this account: check the details.
He add comment. E go dey record.
Approve, and the card go clear.

en: Ikenna turns on the app lock.
In Settings, he taps App lock.
He can choose when it asks.
Taskiem is locked until he proves it.
pcm: Ikenna turn on the app lock.
For Settings, he tap App lock.
He fit choose when e go ask.
Taskiem lock until he prove say na am.
